principles.remaining_action: Evaluate useful midday trips and first/last journeys per site.
principles.supported_conclusion: H30 peaks and piecewise waits rechecked; H120 reduces midday opportunities.
principles.title: Frequency and span determine whether a service is genuinely usable

principles.remaining_action: Publish walking/waiting/ride components separately; do not manufacture a demand-weighted ranking.
principles.supported_conclusion: Actual within-trip rides available; no spatialised passenger OD or certified weighted GJT.
principles.title: Use generalised journey time, not route kilometres, as the passenger-facing measure

principles.remaining_action: Reconcile legibility, rail phasing and endpoint coverage without calling an engineering example the public timetable.
principles.supported_conclusion: Stable two-pattern geometry but irregular departure minutes; strict clockface diagnostic reported separately.
principles.title: Clockface regularity and memorability are real service quality

principles.remaining_action: Obtain applicable rail events, midday target journeys and physical transfer times.
principles.supported_conclusion: 297 per-site checks on frozen targets, not current all-day interchange.
principles.title: The S8 connection is part of the bus trip, not an external bonus

principles.remaining_action: Validate running/dwell distributions, fleet availability, driver duties and depot movements.
principles.supported_conclusion: Nine timing cases and recovery scenarios, four nominal/up to six stress vehicles; no empirical probability.
principles.title: Reliability must constrain the design before frequency is advertised

principles.remaining_action: Review all-site directional rides; no arbitrary ride-time acceptance threshold is adopted.
principles.supported_conclusion: Local short rides and finite-domain shortest road orders do not prove all passenger journeys are short.
principles.title: Directness matters, but coverage and directness are a trade-off

principles.remaining_action: Check actual ordered boarding sides, safe stop space and six manoeuvres; audit acceleration/braking representation.
principles.supported_conclusion: Stop retention/relocation alternatives and walking trade-offs explored; no site authorisation.
principles.title: Stop spacing is an access-versus-speed optimisation problem

principles.remaining_action: Specify route identity, destination displays, FS through-service or transfer, and public timetable.
principles.supported_conclusion: Two full wing patterns, no partial trips in this witness; same vehicle is not same passenger service.
principles.title: Simple networks create useful connections

principles.remaining_action: Keep old evidence scoped; no universal optimality or passenger relocation count without supporting data.
principles.supported_conclusion: Prior generated alternatives and retention trade-offs exist; current result is conditional on four paths.
principles.title: Preserve continuity where it helps, but do not inherit the old network blindly

principles.remaining_action: Report weak areas and central-hour losses; no undeclared coverage floor, score or fabricated OD.
principles.supported_conclusion: Municipal walking catchments retained, not temporal utility or observed passengers.
principles.title: Coverage and ridership are different objectives; expose the trade-off

principles.remaining_action: Check external destinations and useful onward rail journeys using supported evidence.
principles.supported_conclusion: Five-municipality feeder concept with rail hub, not only Olgiate.
principles.title: Functional-area planning is the correct geographic scale

principles.remaining_action: Verify south perimeter, step-free paths, safe crossings and station interchange.
principles.supported_conclusion: Potential pedestrian access and separate south/north points; proxy is not whole-neighbourhood coverage.
principles.title: Accessibility and multimodal integration are first-class outcomes

ride_semantics: Nominal x1.1 moving, 0.5 dwell. Earliest within-trip alighting from FS and latest boarding to FS are separate ordered events. Optimistic conditional boarding; exclude walk, wait, rail and inter-trip transfers. No observed demand, universal directness test or implicit acceptable maximum.
scope: Current 10-16/H120 witness, inherited BP-01..12 and prior-work map; not an exhaustive audit of every historical conversation or branch. No ranking or new normative thresholds.
